Name: Datazag
Author: Datazag - support@datazag.com
Description:
The [Datazag](https://datazag.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel delivers impersonation and attacker-infrastructure indicators derived from Certificate Transparency at issuance time, published as STIX 2.1 objects over a TAXII 2.1 server.

Indicators are ingested using Microsoft Sentinel's built-in **Threat Intelligence - TAXII** data connector and land in the native **ThreatIntelIndicators** table. No custom table, data collection rule or workspace function is required, and indicators are available to analytics rules and hunting queries immediately. Because indicators are retained in the workspace, existing logs can also be retro-hunted against them.

**Prerequisites:**

a. An active Datazag subscription. Contact Datazag to obtain the API root, collection ID and credentials.

b. Analytic rules and hunting queries in this solution query DNS activity through the [Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/normalization). The relevant ASIM parsers must be deployed in the workspace for this content to return results.

**Setting up the data feed:**

Indicators are delivered over TAXII 2.1 and are ingested by Microsoft Sentinel's built-in **Threat Intelligence - TAXII** data connector. This solution therefore ships no data connector of its own.

1. Contact Datazag to obtain your API root URL, collection ID and credentials.

2. In Microsoft Sentinel, open **Data connectors**, select **Threat Intelligence - TAXII** and choose **Open connector page**.

3. Add a collection using the API root URL and collection ID supplied by Datazag, with the username and password from your subscription. Choose a friendly name of your choice — the content in this solution identifies Datazag indicators by their STIX `created_by_ref` identity, not by the friendly name, so any name works.

4. Confirm indicators are arriving by querying the **ThreatIntelIndicators** table.
